d: Long, flowing jet black hair with choppy bangs and a small ahoge atop the head frames a youthful, child-like face. Wide, golden-yellow eyes with a neutral, blank expression characterize the appearance. The build is petite and small, dressed in a dark navy-blue sailor-style outfit consisting of a long-sleeved top with a white collar and a matching pleated skirt, accented by a brown belt. The look is completed with dark navy socks and brown lace-up boots, while the character is posed with dark grey metallic naval weaponry.
